currentParagraphText: “Hey, let’s be fair to Jake here!” Minaga came in to defend the poor Chosen. “He could totally gather a harem. Would he then end up absolutely miserable and be unable to retain this harem as everything quickly spirals into disaster? Obviously, but he could get one started.”

finalResult.nextParagraphText: Jake felt very attacked, but he couldn’t exactly argue against what they said, as he knew that any follow-up questions would tear him apart. He barely knew how to be a partner to one person, and based on everything the Sword Saint had said, maintaining and developing multiple relationships at once while balancing them all would be… complicated. And Jake really didn’t like complicated.
